morphology.pattern_note: 按一种常见英语读法可分为 /læn.di/，词末 y 读 /i/。这不是马来语后缀，不能据此拆出马来语词根 land。

senses.nuances: 资料包没有定义或上下文，因此此处采用专名解释，不能据此确立马来语普通词义，也不能排除特定上下文中的其他专名用途。实际人名应大写 Landy；noun 表示 kata nama khas。IPA 是暂用的英语读法，以本人读法为准。以下是教学示例句式，未证实为高频搭配；未确认马来语派生词族，故 word_family 为空。status 是请求指定值，不代表 DBP 认证。姓氏依据：[Dictionary of American Family Names，经 Ancestry 展示](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/landy)。

etymology.historical_story: Landy has more than one documented surname history. The Dictionary of American Family Names records Irish, English, French and Ashkenazic Jewish derivations, including connections with Lalande, Landay and Landau. These alternatives show why spelling alone cannot establish one person's ancestry. The packet identifies no bearer, so no single history can safely be assigned here. [Source: Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/landy).
